title: Doctor
current: Doctor reports operational health through the registered engine and project checks. From a folder outside every project it runs only machine-scope checks, so `yoke doctor run --only harness-setup --fix` repairs machine setup anywhere, and names each skipped project-scope check N/A with project_required and its recovery. Contributors remain responsible for immediately purging retired code, terms and data; repository vocabulary scanners and per-item stale-copy audit gates are removed. Ordinary runs outside an agent session report the three session readiness checks as N/A with session_required; explicit session, install or named-check selections still fail on missing required session evidence. Status shows the resulting health receipt.
